title: Control GPS logbook — Celia run
content:
Purpose: quick, noisy log for mapping controls to actual signals and evidence. Not polished — a working compass.

Background/context:
- Aim: get a 'GPS' style map: for each trust control, record the concrete telemetry, artifact locations, owners, and known gaps.
- Audience: me (Celia) + anyone who needs a quick read before a triage call.

Running notes (raw):
- Control: Access reviews (A-2?) => signal candidates: Okta group export, last_modified timestamp on audit CSV, HR offboarding events. Where: S3 /sec-audit/okta-exports/, Confluence page for cadence. Owner: Jenna (IAM).
- Control: Deployment approvals (change mgmt) => signal: PR label (+reviewer list), infra pipeline logs (deploy.triggered_by), time-between-approve-and-deploy metric. Gap: no persistent archive of approvals tied to commit SHA. Jira ticket: SEC-712.
- Control: Key management => signal: KMS rotation logs, HSM access events, KMS CMK metadata. Question: do we keep rotation proof for 3rd‑party HSM? Where archived?

Quick TODOs:
- export last 6 months of Okta group CSVs and stash under /users/celia/evidence-temp — label with date and note.
- prototype small script to map PR labels -> deploy events (use GH webhook logs). Owner: Marco.
- ask infra: is there a way to join pipeline metadata to commit hash in retention store? If not, list mitigation.

Risk questions to surface in review call:
- Which controls currently rely on ephemeral signals that we don't retain for 12+ months? (e.g., pipeline logs older than retention window)
- Which owners think the current artifact locations are "source of truth" vs. "convenience copies"? We need authoritative lists.
- Any manual work that has no reproducible artifact (verbal approvals, slack thumbs-up)?

Mapping sketch (rough coordinate style):
- A: Identity & Access -> Okta exports (S3) + HR offboard webhook (logs) -> Owner: IAM -> Gap: retention + automation of evidence pull
- B: Change control -> Github PR label + CI deploy metadata -> Owner: Platform -> Gap: joinability of records + signed approval record
- C: Secrets -> KMS/HSM logs -> Owner: KeyOps -> Gap: 3rd-party rotation proof, export format

Evidence playbook snippets (to formalize later):
- When asked for an "access review" sample provide: Okta group export (CSV), timestamped Slack convo pointing to review, reviewer list, and HR termination CSV for the sample period.
- For a deploy approval sample provide: PR diff, screenshot of approval (or Github audit event), pipeline run id, and post-deploy alert that indicates release.

Notes to self / heuristics:
- If owner says "we have it" -> ask for exact file path + one example artifact (don’t accept pointers).
- Prefer concrete timestamps and SHA IDs.
- When in doubt, capture the human workflow as well as the machine evidence (helps reproduce).

Open items / triage for Friday sync:
- Jenna to confirm Okta export retention policy and where historic exports live.
- Platform to share sample mapping of PR->deploy for last 30 deploys.
- KeyOps to provide example of KMS rotation evidence for a rotated key in last 12 months.

Reference links (handy):
- Confluence: Internal control catalogue (INFRA-SEC-ops-824)
- Slack thread: #trust-evidence (search: "evidence pull 2026-01")
- Jira: SEC-712 (change control provenance)

End-of-run note: this is intentionally messy. Clean version will live in Confluence under 'control-maps' after the Friday sync. For now, grab artifacts and drop them in /users/celia/evidence-temp with a README listing what each file demonstrates.
